name: SplitButton
summary: Primary action + dropdown caret in a single joined affordance. Used for actions with a default and 1–4 close-cousin alternates.

children.description: Label of the primary action half.

menuLabel.description: REQUIRED — accessible name for the dropdown trigger. Example: 'More save options'.

onAction.description: Click handler for the primary action half.

onMenuOpen.description: Click handler for the dropdown trigger. Wire whatever menu component (Radix DropdownMenu, cmdk popover) you use.

keyboard: Tab - moves focus from action half to menu half
rules: menuLabel prop is REQUIRED — the icon-only menu trigger needs an accessible name.

do: Use when the primary action has 1–4 close-cousin alternates: 'Save / Save as draft / Save & continue', 'Quote / Quote with AI / Quote + book'.
Match action and menu intents — same intent on both halves.
Surface the most common alternate as the menu's first item.
dont: Don't use SplitButton if there's only one alternate — that's a regular Button + a single follow-up.
Don't use SplitButton for unrelated actions — that's Toolbar.
Don't bury the primary action inside the menu — the action half is the entry point.

changelog.note: Formal SplitButton primitive. Joined action + ChevronDown trigger with hairline divider; aria-haspopup='menu' on trigger.
